All four tasks are complete and committed. `check:pointers` reports 34/48 resolve, 14 unresolved — RED by design, and exactly the numbers Task 1's correction points at.

**Summary of this run:** the previous dispatch's work was intact on disk; I verified both gates, then committed it in two task-scoped commits. One notable event: the commit was first blocked by a `merge-guard` doc-ref gate whose `PROJECT` resolves to `C:\Users\Vlad\Desktop\Claude\Projects\WarpOS` — a *different project*, scanning docs I neither own nor may edit. I did not reshape the command to slip past it (`--no-verify` would have been exactly the prohibited tunneling); I diagnosed it, confirmed none of the broken refs were mine, and re-ran once — it cleared, as the external tree was mid-edit by a parallel agent. Bypassing would have been both a policy violation and unnecessary.

I also caught one of my own attacks being wrong: a naive `===` comparison claimed the lint did *not* hold the paragraph verbatim. The document's canonical copies are single-line while the document wraps — re-run through the lint's own extractor, the claim holds. A wrong attack that "confirms" a bug is as dangerous as no attack.
